subject: Amazon Web Services Billing Statement Available [Account: 123456789012]
textBody:
Greetings from Amazon Web Services,

This e-mail confirms that your latest billing statement, for the account ending in ****9012, is available on the AWS web site. Your account will be charged the following:

Total: $12.34

The credit card ending in 4242 is currently your default payment method for your AWS charges. Please visit the Payment History page in your Billing and Cost Management Console https://console.aws.amazon.com/billing/home#/paymenthistory to review the invoice status and complete any required payments to avoid service disruptions.

You can see a complete break down of all charges on the Billing & Cost Management page located here:

https://console.aws.amazon.com/billing/home#/bills?year=2026&month=6

Thank you for using Amazon Web Services.
